lede: Pali And Lao accounts for 154 catalogued manuscripts, 1 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Phrae (82% of the corpus for this language), ahead of Chiang Mai and Lampang. Nearly all (96%) are written in Tham Lao · อักษรธรรมลาว script. By support it leans to palm-leaf · ใบลาน (98%) over mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (1%). Dated witnesses run 1719–1920 CE (144 of 154 carry a date).
